title: Links in a panned block have no hover or click
body:
Links inside a code block, or inside a table wider than the transcript, draw in their link colour but get no hover popup and no click. A note on coax-1898d3 puts this down to those blocks panning by columns (`pans` in `App`), so a link's drawn columns depend on the block's pan offset.

## Proposal

When coax draws a panned block, it records each visible link's columns after applying the block's pan offset. A link cut off by the box's edge keeps hover and click on its visible part.
